whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Golpuri Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.4★ reviews in Buddha Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new customer inquiries and menu discovery.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special menu highlights, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/golpuri

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Golpuri Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Golpuri Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and your menu showcase right in Buddha Colony. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur pricing integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
